1. Resource Hierarchy Ordering: min(left, right) then max(left, right)
2. Both Compete for Fork 0 as Their FIRST Fork
Both P0 and P4 compete for
Kant cannot hold Fork 4 and wait for Fork 0!
Deadlock is impossible because circular wait is broken.
All philosophers acquire forks in global ascending resource order:
At most N-1 philosophers can acquire their first fork simultaneously.
The resource dependency graph is a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG).
Therefore, circular wait and deadlock cannot occur.
